title: My House
text:
This is my house. It is small and blue. There is a big kitchen with a table and four chairs. There is also a sofa in the living room.

My bedroom is upstairs. There is a bed, a wardrobe and a lamp. I like my room because it is very bright. My cat sleeps on the bed.

questions.text: Where would the writer probably eat dinner?
options: In the kitchen, at the table
In the bedroom, on the bed
In the garden, on the grass

questions.text: What does the writer probably do in the living room?
options: Sit and relax on the sofa

vocabulary.definition: a room where food is cooked
a tall cupboard where you keep your clothes
on the upper floor of a building

paragraph_translations: Esta é a minha casa. Ela é pequena e azul. Há uma cozinha grande com uma mesa e quatro cadeiras. Há também um sofá na sala de estar.
O meu quarto fica no andar de cima. Há uma cama, um guarda-roupa e um abajur. Eu gosto do meu quarto porque ele é muito claro. O meu gato dorme na cama.
